name: Damon Mabee

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement Mabee lists his occupation as retired, with a background as a substitute teacher, security professional, union field representative and naval officer.
bio.excerpt: Substitute Teacher (OCSD); Unarmed Security Professional; Field Representative (LIUNA 483); Naval Officer

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 37, printed C-36)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists prior service as an Oregon City commissioner and planning commissioner, on the urban renewal commission and budget committee, and on the South Fork Water Board.
bio.excerpt: OC City Commissioner; OC Planning Commissioner; OC Urban Renewal Commissioner and Budget Committee; South Fork Water Board Member and Budget Committee

positions.statement: Mabee says parks are his top priority and that it is time to take another hard look at the city budget to find money to fix the park system.
positions.excerpt: I believe it is time to once again take a hard look at the budget and find the money to fix our Park system.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 37, printed C-36)

positions.statement: Mabee says that, as a retiree on a fixed income, he feels the impact of taxes and fee changes.
positions.excerpt: As a homeowner and a retiree on a fixed income, I feel the impact of taxes and fee changes.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 37, printed C-36)

positions.statement: Mabee says the city needs to decide whether it will be a bedroom community or have its own industries that let people work and live in the same town.
positions.excerpt: we as a City need to decide if we are going to be a bedroom community, or have our own industries that allow people to work and live in the same town.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 37, printed C-36)

positions.statement: Mabee says safe parks are active parks and that safe, local options for residents mean functioning parks and trails.
positions.excerpt: we need safe, local options for our citizens, and that means functioning Parks and Trails. Safe parks are active parks
